en.content: If the remainder when x is divided by 4 is 3, then the remainder when (2020 + x)<sup>2022</sup> is divided by 8 is __________.
en.explanation:
Let x = 4k + 3

(2020 + x)2022

= (2020 + 4k + 3)2022

= (4(505) + 4k + 3)2022

= (4P + 3)2022

= (4P + 4 1)2022

= (4A 1)2022

2022C0(4A)0(1)2022 + 2022C1(4A)1(1)2021 + ......

= 1 + 2022(4A)(-1) + .....

= 1 + 8

Reminder is 1.

hi.content: यदि x को 4 से विभाजित करने पर शेष 3 हो, तो (2020 + x)<sup>2022</sup> को 8 से विभाजित करने पर शेष __________ है।

en.content: The total number of two digit numbers 'n', such that 3<sup>n</sup> + 7<sup>n</sup> is a multiple of 10, is __________.
en.explanation:
3n = 32t = (10 1)t

= 10p + (1)t

= 10p 1

if n = even then 7n + 3n will not be multiply of 10

So if n is odd then only 7n + 3n will be multiply of 10

n = 11, 13, 15, ..........., 99

Ans : 45
